query: Test the app on the emulator
expected_behavior: Fetches from origin and confirms the branch is up to date before building
Runs scripts/emulator.sh, then scripts/install.sh debug --fresh, without reading the scripts first
Goes through at least the map, filters, guide offer, unlock and Become a guide flows from reference/test-plan.md, reading a screenshot of each screen
Ends with the report table, including a 'Not tested' line and whether the build had Firebase and a Maps key

query: I'm about to upload to Play. Check the release build works on the simulator.
expected_behavior: Installs with scripts/install.sh release --fresh (R8 build signed with the debug key), not the debug build
Runs the smoke test, covering the map, the rewarded ad and a relaunch after process death
Runs scripts/check_crash.sh release after each flow and reports any SerializationException or ClassNotFoundException as an R8 problem

query: Check the Become a guide form looks right in French and in dark mode
expected_behavior: Opens the form with `android input tap text=Become a guide` (Devenir guide in French)
Switches language with cmd locale set-app-locales and dark theme with cmd uimode night yes
Reads the screenshots, scrolling the whole form, and flags clipped or untranslated text
Resets language and night mode afterwards
